observations: Reviewed all 27 states across both tilesets and CPU/GPU, using six scaled Before/After contact sheets and nine additional full-resolution frames.

PSX hands have source finger/forearm geometry; no obvious doubled arms, inverted wrists or detached hand/forearm seams were observed in these captures. Primary and support contacts were additionally inspected in the full pistol, rifle, attachment, shotgun and knife frames.

Gloves cover hands while forearms retain skin; worn sleeves remain separate. Actual UDP garment metadata tints the tactical glove green, while the official tileset gives a dark variant; black_gloves is the fixture name, not an assertion that every tileset supplies an identical RGB tint.
Claws and webbing are bounded joint-bound additions. Fur, scales, chitin and bionic finish keep human PSX topology, rather than bespoke fur, creature-anatomy or mechanical-arm meshes.
Hands remain visible at the inspected extreme pitches, camera turn, near wall and vehicle viewpoints.

Real-time attack/switch captures can show different animation phases between CPU/GPU. The gallery is not a pixel-identical timed-pose test; fixed-pose CPU/GPU equivalence and cadence are tested separately.
Vehicle paint differs between independent Before/After fixture creation; this inspection compares hand geometry/visibility and does not claim identical world pixels.
scope: Actual Codex visual inspection completed during functional soak; strict process/gallery validation and all 216 reviewed BMP/RGB hashes now bind that inspection to the completed final PNG export. This is not a manual gameplay session or native performance acceptance.
